title: Deadly fire engulfs power station in southern Iraq
html:
Deadly fire engulfs power station in southern Iraq

At least four people were killed and 30 injured after a fire tore through the Hartha power station complex north of Basra city, sending a huge fireball into the sky. The blaze spread to nearby homes and forced the station to shut down. The cause is still unknown.
summary: At least four people were killed and 30 injured after a fire tore through the Hartha power station complex.
